title: A group's locked name deeper than a setting key's leaf (extensions.ingest_mappers.python) does not stop a later layer from replacing that key
goal: a locked name below a leaf of an object key raises SettingsError naming the lock and the group file when a later layer sets that leaf, as for a name equal to the leaf

run:
import json,os,sys,tempfile,pathlib
sys.path.insert(0,"_tools")
import kbsettings
T=pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
(T/"g.json").write_text(json.dumps({"locked":["extensions.ingest_mappers.python"],"extensions":{"ingest_mappers":{"python":"m:a"}}}))
(T/"settings.json").write_text(json.dumps({"group_settings":"g.json","extensions":{"ingest_mappers":{"python":"x:y"}}}))
try:
    kbsettings.layer_files(T)
except kbsettings.SettingsError as e:
    assert "ingest_mappers" in str(e) and "g.json" in str(e), str(e)
    sys.exit(0)
sys.exit("not yet: a lock below a leaf did not stop a clone layer from setting the leaf")
